dataset: Natural Earth 1:50m rivers and lake centerlines
processing: Selected by published river names, retained line parts, simplified with Shapely tolerance=0.025 degrees preserve_topology=True, rounded to 3 decimals. No invented connections between parts.
limitations: Cartographic river centerlines, not river width, flow volume, inundation, irrigation availability or basin polygons.
Some line parts are reservoir/lake centerlines from the source.
Do not turn river lines or point labels into precise crop suitability boundaries.
